headline: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager | Brand & Performance Marketing
summary: Results-oriented Marketing Manager with a Bachelor of Business Administration and extensive experience in growth strategy, digital marketing, and brand management across fintech and tech sectors. Proven track record of executing data-driven campaigns across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, optimizing ROAS, and managing full-funnel KPIs. Skilled in media buying (Google/Meta), lead generation, and cross-functional stakeholder management. Seeking to leverage strong analytical capabilities, campaign management expertise, and bilingual communication skills to drive brand presence and commercial growth in a new industry vertical.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Developed and executed annual marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, driving user acquisition and engagement across MENA, EU, and Asian markets.
Managed full-funnel KPIs including ROAS, ROA, and conversion rates, optimizing sales funnels and lead generation processes for financial platforms.
Oversaw media buying campaigns on Google and Meta, ensuring effective budget allocation and measurable results through A/B testing and performance analysis.
Led brand management activities, ensuring consistent implementation of brand guidelines across digital touchpoints and customer communications.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Supported user growth and engagement through strategic community management and integrated marketing campaigns.
Executed AMA campaigns and managed KOL relations to build the Arabic crypto ecosystem and enhance brand visibility.
Analyzed market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and support business decisions in a fast-paced environment.

cover_letter: As a Growth & Digital Marketing Manager with a strong background in financial markets and fintech, I bring proven expertise in developing integrated marketing strategies, managing media budgets, and driving lead generation. My experience in optimizing ROAS and managing cross-market campaigns across MENA and EU aligns well with the strategic and analytical demands of this role. I am eager to apply my skills in brand management, digital marketing, and stakeholder collaboration to support Anantara's automotive business growth and brand presence.

screening.q: Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field?
Do you have minimum 10 years of marketing experience?
Do you have strong experience in automotive brand management and integrated campaigns?
screening.a: No, but I have extensive experience in financial/fintech brand management and integrated digital campaigns with transferable skills in brand positioning and campaign execution.

screening.q: Do you have good understanding of the GCC automotive market?
screening.a: No, but I have deep experience in the MENA market, including consumer behavior analysis and cross-cultural communication, which allows for rapid adaptation to new industry verticals.

screening.q: Are you skilled in managing marketing budgets, media planning, and agencies?
Do you have strong analytical capability with experience using marketing data and KPIs?
